original_card.question: Can an explicitly larger or nonabelian register model escape the scoped three-register obstruction?
methods: Construct the smallest exact identity in a newly specified legal operation alphabet.
Derive a target-specific relaxation bound for that same explicit alphabet.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Name the changed hypothesis, all counted roles and a uniform identity; finite column tests alone do not certify it. A scoped local result may be retained without a complete supplier. Expanding it into further construction rounds requires the family-level budget and obligation gate in research-family-status.md; an optimistic passing relaxation alone is not acceptance.

original_card.first_experiment: First compare the alphabet, role count and length with the fully replayed #1974 census and #2027 mixed-root tariff. Identify a changed premise and a legal native implementation; then price one smallest completed instance before searching larger words.
original_card.bottleneck_link: A small-width completed saving changes the bit primitive; a finite-address identity alone is insufficient.
allowed_variations: Choose a fixed larger register count or a specified nonabelian operation family.
scope_change_triggers: Remaining inside the already-excluded three-register abelian model.
Repeating the two-register GL3 census or a covered three-register length without changing a hypothesis; a formal group-algebra word without native conversion is a partial result.

actual_scope: Prove that for every finite register width r>=2, the target diag([xy],[yx],e,...,e) in M_r(F2[A5]) with paid labels {x,y} and every binary rank-one idempotent has exact paid-call minimum 4. Support filter reduces length<=3 to patterns xyx/yxy; each forces the middle projector to the rank-two matrix E00+E11. Answers #2246 / a5-conjugate-5cycle-seedd316f8 algebraic-invariant OQ.
scope_change_reason: Preferred #2687 admitted BIT-supplier bill remains ungrounded without a non-cancellable physical source-return invoice (prior thin tariff/run retargets deferred). Preferred #2888 non-toy fitted-k/GL64 Incoming remains blocked (GL2(F3) toys deferred). The #2246 deferral note prefers an algebraic any-register invariant over further A5 role-count BFS; this package supplies that invariant and stays outside the dirty-role-minimum leave-alone cascade.
bottleneck_link: An all-roles formal floor closes the A5 conjugate spectator question without another width census; a native BIT realization remains a separate obligation before any kappa consequence.
stop_rule: Write the support filter and both coefficient obstructions, replay the direct four-call word at several widths with omission controls, independent even-permutation rebuild, and package tests. Do not run another fixed-width BFS census.
evidence: CERTIFICATE.json: support_patterns=['xyx','yxy']; forced_B_rank=2 on both patterns for roles {2,3,4,5,8}; direct word at roles 2..5; 16 omission rejects; idempotent counts 6/28/120; independent even-permutation closure.
